metas.name: A1 Northwest
metas.note:
• The northwest part of the country has very limited coverage, most of which is on the A1 or in Sibiloi National Park.
  • It has faintly tan soil and sparse low trees.
  • A lot of the coverage in this area is very flat, but you can also see hills or mountains.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kenya.

metas.name: A109 Cord & Orange Dirt
metas.note:
• The A109 between Mombasa and Nairobi has light orange dirt and many hills around the road and in the distance.
  • Most of the coverage between Mombasa and Emali also has a unique car, which has a cord on the left.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kenya.

metas.name: Agriculture Parts
metas.note:
• The far west areas of the country that are northwest and southwest of Kisumu are the most agricultural parts of the country.
  • You will often see farms, grassy hills, and tall eucalyptus trees in this region of the country.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kenya.

metas.name: Dirt Car
metas.note: • This car that is covered in specks of dirt is unique to these stretches of the A3, B9, and the Habaswein-Dadaab Road connecting the two.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kenya.

metas.name: Mombasa White Sand
metas.note: • Mombasa and the other coastal towns are easily identified from the white sandy soil, palm trees and coastal feel.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kenya.

metas.name: Semi-Arid Kitui
metas.note: • The area around Kitui is semi-arid, usually mountainous, and has light orange, sandy dirt.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kenya.

metas.name: White Tape
metas.note: • You can see pieces of white tape on the roof of the Google car in a lot of the coverage north and south of Nairobi.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kenya.
